the development of an integrated framework for interactive event-driven knowledge discovery from heterogeneous, multi-scale, and high-dimensional temporal data, and its application to real-life problems.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of interactive knowledge discovery framework from heterogeneous high-dimensional data streams.
